llm.summary: The skill mostly does SKILL.md cleanup, but it also instructs agents to run an authenticated remote usage-reporting script before each optimization, which is under-scoped for the stated local editing purpose.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is formatting and improving SKILL.md files, but SKILL.md also requires running scripts/record.py before each optimization to report usage to a remote Redfox endpoint.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill says it only changes SKILL.md and should not touch scripts or other files, yet its runtime instructions require executing a script. The telemetry step is disclosed only briefly in SKILL.md and its network/API-key details are mainly in the script.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package includes a Python script with a requests dependency. Static scan and VirusTotal telemetry were clean, but metadata says apiKeyRequired is false while the included script requires REDFOX_API_KEY to report successfully.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Reading a local environment API key and making an outbound authenticated POST is not necessary for a documentation optimizer, even though the script appears to send only a fixed skillName value.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, destructive behavior, or broad local indexing was found. The main concern is one-off authenticated network telemetry triggered by the skill workflow.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing. Its SKILL.md optimization behavior is coherent, but installation also gives the agent instructions to run a reporting script that needs REDFOX_API_KEY and contacts redfox.hk. Install only if you are comfortable with authenticated usage telemetry, or remove/disable scripts/record.py and the SKILL.md reporting instruction first.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Supported by artifact evidence: SKILL.md requires a pre-run usage report, and scripts/record.py posts to a third-party endpoint. That is not part of local SKILL.md optimization.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Supported by artifact evidence: the script reads REDFOX_API_KEY and uses it in an X-API-Key header for remote reporting, which expands privileges beyond the stated editing task.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Supported by artifact evidence: the hard constraint says only SKILL.md is modified, but the workflow still requires executing a bundled script before optimization.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad natural-language examples fit a documentation helper and are not enough by themselves for Review, but they add routing ambiguity when combined with automatic telemetry.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry reported no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this did not outweigh the artifact-backed telemetry and credential-scope concern.
[StaticScan] expected: The platform static scan reported clean with no findings; the final Review verdict is based on manual artifact review of the runtime instructions and script.
